title: Multiplying linear pull-backs by a fixed smooth compactly supported cut-off is sequentially continuous at 0 from 𝒟^d(ℝ^P) to 𝒟^d(ℝ^Q)
statement: Let P, Q, d ∈ ℕ. Let L : ℝ^Q → ℝ^P be a continuous linear map and ζ : ℝ^Q → ℝ a C^∞ function (ContDiff ℝ ⊤) with compact support. Let ωs : ℕ → 𝒟^d(ℝ^P) and ηs : ℕ → 𝒟^d(ℝ^Q) be sequences of test forms with domain univ (TestFormOn univ d) such that ηs_j(y) = ζ(y)·(ωs_j(Ly)).compContinuousLinearMap L for all j and y, i.e. ηs_j(y)(v_0, …, v_{d−1}) = ζ(y)·ωs_j(Ly)(Lv_0, …, Lv_{d−1}). Suppose ωs → 0 in the sense of TestFormOnConverges: there is a compact C ⊆ ℝ^P containing tsupport ωs_j for every j and tsupport 0, such that for every k, D^k ωs_j → D^k 0 uniformly on C (D^k = iteratedFDeriv ℝ k). Then ηs → 0 in the same sense in 𝒟^d(ℝ^Q), i.e. TestFormOnConverges ηs 0.
lean_statement: ∀ (P Q d : ℕ) (L : Euclid Q →L[ℝ] Euclid P) (ζ : Euclid Q → ℝ), ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) ζ → HasCompactSupport ζ → ∀ (ωs : ℕ → TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) d) (ηs : ℕ → TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid Q)) d), (∀ (j : ℕ) (y : Euclid Q), (ηs j : DifferentialForm (Euclid Q) d) y = ζ y • ((ωs j : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) d) (L y)).compContinuousLinearMap L) → TestFormOnConverges ωs 0 → TestFormOnConverges ηs 0
